# OFF AXIS

> OFF AXIS is an independent strategy, audience, experience and business advisory helping organisations in sport, outdoor and culture find new lines of growth.

Canonical website: https://www.offaxis.partners/
French website: https://www.offaxis.partners/fr/
Founder: Joseph Villeflayoux
Based in: South of France, working internationally

## Expertise

- Audiences, insights and positioning
- Brand, narrative and experience
- Partnerships, revenue and value
- Teams, activation and delivery

OFF AXIS combines strategy, project structuring, stakeholder alignment and execution to move opportunities through to delivery.

## Clients and playing fields

- Events and rights holders
- Destinations and resorts
- Sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands
- Leagues and federations

## Background

Joseph Villeflayoux has twenty years of experience across sport, outdoor, media, brands and destinations. His background includes VP Marketing at Hurricane Group (FISE), Head of Communications at the Freeride World Tour (FIS), IOC consulting work on Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024, and more than 500 events and activations.
